game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Sand Dunes – Caravan Camp, a caravan camp: the oasis keeper must handle vultures while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Integration Heist: Combine loops, conditionals, and lists to complete a multi-step script that raids Caravan Camp.
theme: Sand Dunes – Caravan Camp: a caravan camp
core_gameplay_loop: In Caravan Camp, repeat each round: Combine loops, conditionals, and lists to complete a multi-step script that raids Caravan Camp. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the heist value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 5 consecutive correct decisions about heist to power up the oasis keeper and open the palm grove.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 1 (intro tier): Integration Heist
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Integration Heist' (Week 9 slot 7), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Caravan Camp'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how heist changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against vultures in Caravan Camp.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 5.
